scripts.check:syntax: sh -c 'if [ "$#" -gt 0 ]; then for f in "$@"; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done; else find web designer3d/tools .lintstagedrc.mjs -name node_modules -prune -o -path web/vendor -prune -o \( -name "*.js" -o -name "*.mjs" \) -print0 | xargs -0 -n 1 node --check; fi' sh
scripts.lint: npm run check:syntax && npm --prefix web run lint && npm --prefix web run lint:css && npm --prefix designer3d/tools run lint
scripts.format: npm --prefix web run format && npm --prefix designer3d/tools run format
scripts.format:check: npm --prefix web run format:check && npm --prefix designer3d/tools run format:check && npm run format:kotlin
